topic: Pangong Lake spans India and China, freezes in winter
hook: Your photo at Pangong Lake is taken on two countries at once.
title: Your Pangong Lake Photo Is in Two Countries
description:
Pangong Lake in Ladakh spans India and China. Its water is salty, yet it freezes over in winter. Part of the Places That Shouldn't Exist series.

#Shorts #PangongLake #Ladakh
